title: Unregistering Ctrl+Alt+Y retains its callback when registered again
body: On Windows 11 in Electron 42.4.1, globalShortcut.register Ctrl+Alt+Y logs A. After globalShortcut.unregister, isRegistered is false. Registering the same key with callback B makes one key press call both A and B. No menu is installed; restart restores a single callback.
